history.summary: Modern TTD temple on a 10-acre hill at Endada near Rushikonda, about 1.2 km from Rushikonda Beach, overlooking the Bay of Bengal. Built by the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams at a reported cost of about Rs 28 crore as part of TTD's mission to build Srivari temples across India, with maha samprokshana held March 18-23, 2022 and grand kumbhabhishekam in March 2023; rituals follow the Vaikhanasa agama. FLAG -- probable CSV duplicate: seq 9 ('Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple', Visakhapatnam) was documented as the TTD Sri Venkateswara Divya Kshetram at Rushikonda with identical coordinates (17.77847, 83.37917). This row appears to be the same temple under a fuller name; keep-or-merge decision needed. Id kept unique from seq 9's 'sri-venkateswara-swamy-temple-visakhapatnam'.

name: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple, Rushikonda
town_description: Visakhapatnam (Vizag) is Andhra Pradesh's largest city and a major port on the Bay of Bengal, backed by the Eastern Ghats. Rushikonda, in the city's north, is a beach suburb known for Rushikonda Beach and the hilltop TTD Venkateswara temple.

travel.railway: Visakhapatnam Junction (city railhead; taxis and buses to Rushikonda)
travel.road: Rushikonda Hill, Endada; about 12 km from the city center via Beach Road and the Rushikonda-Endada road; city buses, taxis and autos available

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Brahmotsavam for the main festival
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-8:00 PM daily per most guides (some listings show 5:00 AM-8:00 PM or 6:00 AM-8:30 PM); short darshan breaks for rituals (around 12:00-1:00 PM and 6:00-7:00 PM) -- verify before visiting
